sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Genjutsu (Tactile), Fuinjutsu, Yin Release, Finisher

system.description:
You draw a Yin Seal into your palm, as Black Yin Chakra washes over your striking limb. Make a melee Taijutsu attack dealing 4d10 necrotic damage and if the target has ranks of Sealed or is marked with a Yin Seal, they must make a Charisma saving throw.

Finisher: on a hit, you instead deal your [Unarmed damage] + 4d10 necrotic damage, and they make their Charisma saving throw at disadvantage.

Critical Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.

Success: Affected creature takes 2d6 chakra damage if they are marked with a Yin Seal.

Failure: Affected creature takes 1d6 chakra damage for every rank of Sealed they have and an additional 2d6 chakra damage if they are marked with a Yin Seal.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, you now gain 2 Temporary chakra for every rank of Sealed they have and 4 Temporary Chakra if they are marked with a Yin Seal.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d10.
